trends.name: Iran War & Oil Supply Shock
trends.summary: Iran rejected ceasefire proposal as White House signals no signed deal yet. Qatar LNG tankers abandoning Hormuz crossing attempts; UAE energy infrastructure damaged by Iranian strikes. Oil markets pricing WTI toward $150 by year-end, with crude up 12% since last Wednesday and energy stocks surging (Phillips 66, United Airlines benefiting from higher fuel/ticket prices).

trends.name: Fed Rate Cuts Disappearing in 2026
trends.summary: Markets now pricing zero Fed rate cuts as most likely outcome for 2026, with odds rising sharply. Wells Fargo reversed prior forecast for two cuts and now expects rates held steady. This signals prolonged higher rates and potential headwind for equities dependent on rate cuts.

trends.name: Netflix Breakout Above $100
trends.summary: Netflix stock surges past $100 driven by price hike success, accelerating ad revenue growth, and live sports expansion (boxing, NFL). Demonstrates pricing power and diversification beyond core streaming, signaling resilience in high-rate environment.

trends.name: Tesla 60% Downside Warning
trends.summary: JPMorgan analyst issues 'high degree of caution' with 60% downside price target on Tesla stock. Thesis points to weak 2026 start and demand pressures, contrasting with Palantir bullish positioning as leading AI beneficiary.

trends.name: S&P 500 Correction Risk to 6,000
trends.summary: Analysts warn S&P 500 could drop to 6,000 before reaching fresh highs, with April called a 'do or die' month for markets. Current level near 6,590; broader concern about sustainability of rally amid geopolitical tension, elevated rates, and valuation concerns. Strategists warn against chasing relief rallies.

trends.name: AI Sector Rotation & Google's Impact
trends.summary: Google's recent moves 'sucker-punched' highflying tech stocks, signaling rotation out of narrow AI winners. ARM's CPU bottleneck thesis intensifying; Qualcomm facing biggest strategic shift. Datadog and infrastructure plays gaining relative strength as investors diversify AI exposure beyond mega-cap chipmakers.

trends.name: Employment Resilience vs. Gen Z Weakness
trends.summary: ADP weekly payrolls positive through mid-November with no recent cutbacks, supporting labor market strength. However, Gen Z graduates face tough job market with many earning below $50k pursuing 'AI-proof' careers (education, biology, pharmacy), signaling bifurcated employment picture and potential structural wage pressures.

trends.name: Rare Earth & Critical Materials Rally
trends.summary: MP Materials positioned as 'buy the dip' rare earth play with huge upside amid geopolitical uncertainty and strategic commodity demand. Iran tensions and supply chain concerns driving reopened interest in domestic critical mineral production and defense-related materials.

trends.name: CrowdStrike & Cybersecurity Stock Buybacks
trends.summary: CrowdStrike aggressively buying back its own beaten-down stock, signaling management confidence despite recent operational setbacks. Reflects broader insider conviction in security sector recovery and valuation floor amid market volatility.

trends.name: Trump Administration Policy Reshaping Markets
trends.summary: Trump's Iran ultimatum creating market volatility; new Trump Accounts app via Robinhood/BNY signals fintech integration. Security team deputization controversy adds political/operational risk layers. Policy uncertainty continues driving geopolitical premium in markets.

trends.name: Healthcare Insurer Friction & Sector Pressure
trends.summary: Widespread frustration from both patients and doctors fighting health insurers signals potential regulatory/reputational pressure on insurance stocks. Could drive margin compression and policy changes, though broader healthcare plays (Eisai/Biogen Leqembi, Neurocrine) showing M&A activity.

trends.name: Treasurys & Duration Asset Reallocation
trends.summary: Investor shift from CDs to Treasurys amid rate uncertainty suggests duration repositioning. Higher structural rates favoring bond income over equities for conservative allocators, while cryptocurrency volatility (Ethereum ETFs emerging) indicates speculative capital seeking returns elsewhere.
